items.question: Does a child need an account to use public games or lessons?
items.answer: No. Public games, lessons and learning areas can be opened without creating an account.

items.question: What does the pupil homepage change?
items.answer: It changes presentation and navigation only. It does not create a child profile, grant permissions or hide other public content.

items.question: Is the mailing list connected to an account?
items.answer: No. Teacher updates use a separate adult mailing-list process, and creating an account never subscribes anyone.

items.question: Does Made by Matt replace school or safeguarding advice?
items.answer: No. Made by Matt provides learning content and tools. Official external material is labelled by publisher in the Education Hub.
